name: Chalet Windegg
beschreibung:
Set on an elevated, sunny hillside in St. Anton am Arlberg, Chalet Windegg captivates guests with sweeping views of surrounding alpine peaks. Thoughtfully appointed residences deliver modern alpine elegance.

Winter sport enthusiasts enjoy fast access to the sprawling Ski Arlberg slopes. In summer, the chalet serves as an ideal launchpad for mountain excursions and climbing routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Windegg in St. Anton am Arlberg offers stylish living in a sunny panoramic location with direct access to Ski Arlberg.
